info.title: NOVA – Beyond the Mission API
info.summary: Authoritative gameplay backend for the NOVA 3D web game.
info.description:
**NOVA – Beyond the Mission** · *Explore. Experience. Execute.*

Authoritative gameplay backend for the NOVA 3D web game. The React Three Fiber
client owns movement, camera and animation; this service owns **mission rules,
resources, inventory, physics simulations, continuity and persistence**.

### What is modelled
* **8 stages / 15 missions** – Training Facility → Earth Analog → Mars Arrival →
  Crew Health → Flame in Freefall → Martian Guide → Lunar Landing → Earth Trends.
* **Move → interact → consequence** – every action validates its preconditions.
  Repairing a pressurised pipe fails, wastes a kit and costs water.
* **Mission Continuity System** – preparation quality, maintenance and resource
  discipline carry over into later stages as explainable modifiers.
* **Server-authoritative simulations** – lunar descent, microgravity fire, crew
  vitals and rover traverses are integrated on the server.
* **Scientific honesty** – every payload labels its provenance (`live`, `cache`,
  `bundled`, `simulated`) and educational simplifications are stated explicitly.

### Conventions
* All game state lives under `/api/v1/games/{game_id}`.
* Errors use one envelope: `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}, "request_id"}`.
* Writes accept `Idempotency-Key`; enable `NOVA_AUTH_ENABLED` to require `X-Session-Token`.
* Legacy Prototype-01 URLs (`/games`, `/games/{id}/missions/water-leak`) still work.

post.description:
Import the bundle produced by ``GET /games/{id}/export``.

A **new** game id is always issued, so importing can never overwrite an
existing campaign. Side records (reports, samples, simulator runs) are
re-keyed and the references inside the save are rewritten to match.

post.summary: Perform one interaction (scan, close valve, repair, collect…)
post.description:
The heart of NOVA: *move → interact → consequence*.

The server validates every precondition. Repairing a pipe before closing
the valve fails, wastes a repair kit and costs water – exactly like the
real procedure. The response carries the animation to play, the resource
delta and the refreshed mission state so the HUD needs no extra requests.

post.description:
Escape hatch for a run gone wrong: objectives reset, history does not.

The attempt counter grows and every mistake stays on the record, so the
mission score and the continuity readiness still reflect the real run.

Content authors must use exactly these four levels: the frontend maps each
one to a colour/label, so an invented level ("very_high", "medium") silently
breaks the science panel. ``validate_content`` enforces the vocabulary.

``payload`` carries action parameters declared by the mission definition
(for example ``{"site": "delta_flats"}``). Unknown fields are rejected by
the engine with a 422 so typos never silently pass.

This is the same document the engine executes, so the frontend can

Which fields are present depends on ``kind``: the lander ships a terrain
profile, the rover ships waypoints and hazards, the fire and vitals models
are cabin-scale and need no geometry.

StreamStats.description:
Live fan-out counters, as reported by the process-local event bus.

Process-local by design: with several workers each one reports its own
sockets, which is exactly what an operator debugging a sticky-session
problem needs to see.
